title: 第二十一章玩弄邪修李长寿的癖好第二十二章子嗣降生突破元婴巅峰
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 叶家飞舟腾空而起，除了叶英俊全都离开了黑风城。
天穹上传来嗖的一声，就连那怒雷也随之消失。
直到飞舟消失的无影无踪，虚空恢复平静，下方被强行压倒在地的百姓才敢开口。
“我是不是看错了，那名叶家长老视咱们如蝼蚁，居然还留下了一名化神期大能。”
“爸了个根的，你不会以为是叶山君那老东西心善了吧！还让老头和人家怀胎的妻子跪拜，简直就是禽兽不如。”
“要不是我只有练气修为，高低要冲过去为他们讨个公道。”
“嘘，都小点声，咱们城里可还有一个叶家化神，你们不想活了？”
众人下意识地目光看向李府，随后鸦雀无声，消失在街道，返回家中龟缩起来，生怕报复。
叶英俊看到这一幕，无奈地捂了捂头，更是嘴角忍不住抽了抽。
他算是看明白了，叶家那高高在上的正派形象，这一刻全都在黑风城败光了。
好在他并未跟随大部队启程，倒是可以消停一段时间了。
“多谢前辈仗义出手，不然我们能否再看到大小姐还是两说。”
“今后我叶英俊就定居在黑风城，有任何差遣还请告知。”
叶英俊面带笑容，对着李长寿行了一礼，声音还特地加上了‘前辈’尊称。
方才大小姐就能给他讲述了李长寿两次救她的场面。
只不过叶夕瑶隐去了一些不必要的声音，让叶英俊见李长寿如见她。
这种遇强则强实力不详的老银币才是最可怕的。
“真是客气，夕瑶那孩子在黑风城一直都在为民除害。”
“老朽只是不忍心身死，这才出手点拨。”李长寿伸手将叶英俊扶起，苍老的脸颊上依旧冷淡。
经过叶山君的事他虽然对这叶家没什么好感，可是伸手不打笑脸人这件事他还是懂得。
且看叶英俊今后的表现，到底是不是叶山君的眼线。
“无论如何真是多谢了，太虚灵瞳对我们叶家至关重要。”叶英俊用神识探查了一下全城的情况，挑选了一副富足的地界，“今后我就住在城东，前辈要是有事传音给我便好。”
说完叶英俊留下一枚传音玉简，化作一道神虹消失在原地。
李长寿捏了那枚玉简，这质感就像是捏着一块翡翠，灵气环绕，滑滑的。
妥妥的就是高级货，说不定能够卖很多灵石。
“那个叫叶英俊的笑容太假了，咱们可要多多提防才是。”
“还有刚才那个老头，真是丧心病狂，夫君可要小心了。”
楚玉璃和苏千凡两女经过刚才的惊吓，显然是还没有从先前的状态缓过来。
这个时候就算叶英俊送上一块稀世珍宝，她们也会认为里面必然藏着一把刀。
李长寿也觉得风险太大，刚想跑路，那枚玉简就开始震动。
“老爷子，留下的这个人算是我的亲信，绝对信得过，就算是让他自刎归天也绝对没有问题的。”
远在千里之外，叶夕瑶的声音从里面传出，打消了李长寿的疑心。
“放心，为夫自有决断。”
“外面凉，咱们先进屋吧！”
房间中，在安抚完两位夫人休息后，李长寿取出斩杀邪修的战利品。
六名金丹邪修的乾坤戒有着几部邪修功法，里面的血灵石足有上万之多。
content_en:
The Ye family's flying boat took off into the sky, and everyone except Ye Yingjun left Black Wind City.
There was a whooshing sound in the sky, and even the angry thunder disappeared.
It wasn't until the flying boat disappeared without a trace and the void returned to calm that the people below who were forced to the ground dared to speak.
"Did I see it wrong? That Mr. Ye treats us like ants, but he actually left behind a great master in the transformation stage."
"You know your father, you don't think that old guy Ye Shanjun has a kind heart, do you? And asking the old man to kneel down and worship his pregnant wife is simply worse than a beast."
"If I hadn't only had Qi training, I would have rushed over to seek justice for them."
"Shh, please keep your voices down. There is still a Ye family incarnation in our city. Don't you want to live anymore?"
Everyone subconsciously looked at Li Mansion, then fell silent, disappeared into the street, returned home and huddled up, for fear of revenge.
When Ye Yingjun saw this scene, he covered his head helplessly, and the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch.
He finally understood that the Ye family's aloof and upright image was completely ruined in Black Wind City at this moment.
Fortunately, he did not set off with the large army, so he could rest for a while.
"Thank you, senior, for your generous action, otherwise it's hard to say whether we could see the eldest lady again."
"From now on, I, Ye Yingjun, will be settling in Black Wind City. Please let me know if you have any errands."
Ye Yingjun smiled and saluted Li Changshou, adding the honorific title of 'senior' in his voice.
Just now, the eldest lady was able to tell him about the two times Li Changshou saved her.
It's just that Ye Xiyao suppressed some unnecessary sounds, letting Ye Yingjun see Li Changshou as if he were seeing her.
This old silver coin with unknown strength is the most terrifying thing.
"You're so polite. That kid Xiyao has been doing harm to the people in Black Wind City."
"I just couldn't bear to die, so I intervened." Li Changshou stretched out his hand to lift Ye Yingjun up, his old face still cold.
Although he didn't have a good impression of the Ye family after what happened to Mr. Ye Shan, he still knew how to avoid hitting the smiling man.
Let’s see how Ye Yingjun behaves in the future to see if he is Ye Shanjun’s spy.
"In any case, thank you very much. The Taixu Spiritual Eye is very important to our Ye family." Ye Yingjun used his spiritual sense to explore the situation in the city and chose a rich area. "I will live in the east of the city from now on. If you have anything, senior, please send me a message."
After saying that, Ye Yingjun left behind a sound transmission jade slip, which turned into a divine rainbow and disappeared in place.
Li Changshou pinched the jade slip. The texture was like holding a piece of jade, surrounded by spiritual energy and smooth.
It's definitely a high-end product, and you might be able to sell a lot of spiritual stones.
"That smile called Ye Yingjun is too fake, we have to be careful."
"And that old man just now is really crazy. Husband, you should be careful."
Chu Yuli and Su Qianfan had obviously not recovered from their previous state after being frightened just now.
At this time, even if Ye Yingjun presented a rare treasure, they would think that there must be a knife hidden inside.
Li Changshou also felt that the risk was too great. Just as he was about to run away, the jade slip began to vibrate.
"Old man, the person left behind is considered a close confidant of mine. I can definitely trust him. Even if I let him kill himself and die, there will be no problem."
Thousands of miles away, Ye Xiyao's voice came from inside, dispelling Li Changshou's suspicion.
"Don't worry, your husband will make his own decision."
"It's cold outside, let's go inside first!"
In the room, after comforting the two ladies to rest, Li Changshou took out the trophies from killing the evil cultivator.
The Qiankun Ring of the six golden elixir evil cultivators has several evil cultivation techniques, and there are tens of thousands of blood spirit stones in it.
